Let's find which fraction of the circle is shaded. That's what the sector formula means anyway. We have a forty and a hundred twenty, and we know what part of the circle each one is.

[short pause] A hundred twenty degrees is a third of the circle, because three hundred sixty divided by three is a hundred twenty. Forty degrees is a ninth, because three hundred sixty divided by nine is forty.
